content.short: DraftKings Marketplace is a fantasy sports site where fans can buy NFTs.
content.description: DraftKings Marketplace began as a betting platform for fantasy sports players and has since expanded to include an NFT marketplace. Fantasy sports remain a popular hobby in both football and gaming, and this addition lets fans buy NFTs that celebrate famous sports icons. By pairing collectible digital art with fantasy sports, the DraftKings Marketplace adds a new, immersive layer to how fans engage with their favorite athletes and leagues.
content.meta: DraftKings Marketplace is an NFT marketplace and fantasy sports platform. Discover DraftKings Marketplace and other NFT Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
